description: Remove duplicate CI test jobs and chain deploy-docker to build on tag creation

userStories.title: Fix duplicate test job triggers
userStories.description: As a devops engineer, I want test jobs to run exactly once per PR push, not duplicated by both push and pull_request triggers.
acceptanceCriteria: In .github/workflows/test.yml, change push trigger branches from '*' to only 'development' and 'main'
pull_request trigger remains unchanged (opened, synchronize, reopened)
paths-ignore lists remain the same on both triggers
YAML is valid and properly indented

userStories.title: Chain deploy-docker to auto-trigger after build on tag
userStories.description: As a developer, I want deploy-docker to automatically trigger after a successful build on tag creation.
acceptanceCriteria: In .github/workflows/deploy-docker.yml, add workflow_run trigger that fires after Build workflow completes
Add condition to only deploy if workflow_run conclusion is 'success'
Extract tag from github.event.workflow_run.head_branch for auto-trigger or inputs.tag for manual trigger
Keep existing workflow_dispatch trigger as manual fallback
Keep the existing 'rc' tag filter condition
YAML is valid and properly indented

userStories.title: Verify and push all changes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to ensure all changes are committed and visible in the PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify if there are any remaining changes by running git status. If remaining changes exist, commit and push to branch.
